mitsuhiro-arita.name: Mitsuhiro Arita
mitsuhiro-arita.bio: Mitsuhiro Arita is one of the most legendary illustrators in trading card game history. Working with the Pokémon Trading Card Game since its inception with the 1996 Base Set, Arita illustrated the iconic original Base Set Charizard, Pikachu, and Mewtwo. His painterly, dynamic style captures realistic lighting, weight, and vibrant natural habitats.

ken-sugimori.name: Ken Sugimori
ken-sugimori.bio: Ken Sugimori is a Japanese video game designer, manga artist, and art director, best known as the character designer and art director for the Pokémon franchise. Alongside Satoshi Tajiri, he co-founded Game Freak. His classic watercolor character designs defined the aesthetic of the original 151 Pokémon and early card releases.
notableWorks: Original Generation I & II Pokémon Designs

kagemaru-himeno.name: Kagemaru Himeno
kagemaru-himeno.bio: Kagemaru Himeno is one of the most beloved and prolific illustrators in Pokémon Trading Card Game history, having illustrated over 650 cards since the classic Jungle expansion. Also known as a talented manga artist, Himeno's distinctive soft watercolor style, warm lighting, and endearing depictions of Pokémon in everyday scenes have made her artworks iconic across generations.

5ban-graphics.name: 5ban Graphics
5ban-graphics.bio: 5ban Graphics is an in-house digital CGI design group formed within Creatures Inc. Since the Black & White era, 5ban Graphics has been responsible for modeling and rendering hundreds of full-art Pokémon Ultra Rares, Pokémon-EX, Pokémon-GX, and Pokémon VSTAR cards.

kankurou.name: kankurou
kankurou.bio: kankurou is one of the premier illustrators for the ONE PIECE Card Game, renowned for intense, battle-ready character expressions, thick dynamic ink lines, and high-impact action poses across numerous Leader cards and Super Rares.

koushi-rokushiro.name: Koushi Rokushiro
koushi-rokushiro.bio: Koushi Rokushiro is a prominent illustrator contributing heavily to the ONE PIECE Card Game. Famous for vivid colors and comic-book energetic perspectives that bring Eiichiro Oda's characters into thrilling card art.
notableWorks: One Piece ST-01 to ST-14 Starter Deck Arts

eiichiro-oda.name: Eiichiro Oda
eiichiro-oda.role: Creator of ONE PIECE & Manga Artist
eiichiro-oda.bio: Eiichiro Oda is the creator and author of ONE PIECE, the best-selling manga series in history with over 516 million copies in circulation. His original manga artwork panels, celebratory anniversary drawings, and signature Manga Alternate Art cards are the most prestigious and valuable grails in the ONE PIECE Card Game.
notableWorks: Manga Alternate Art Super Parallels (Luffy, Zoro, Roger, Shanks, Law)

six-more-vodka.name: Six More Vodka
six-more-vodka.bio: Six More Vodka is a world-class design and concept art studio based in Berlin, Germany. Renowned for rich cinematic lighting, moody atmospheric storytelling, and master-level anatomical rendering across fantasy card art and worldbuilding.

kudos-productions.name: Kudos Productions
kudos-productions.bio: Kudos Productions is a premier digital art and illustration studio providing high-end character illustration, splash art, and card illustrations for global gaming franchises.

naoki-saito.name: Naoki Saito
naoki-saito.bio: Naoki Saito is a highly acclaimed Japanese illustrator and educator. Renowned for creating some of the most sought-after and valuable Full Art Trainer cards in Pokémon TCG history (including Lillie, Sightseer, and Lisia), known for expressive facial eyes and beautiful clean line work.
